observations: Photo 0: large diesel engine block being lifted by chain/hoist onto blue pallets, inside/near a shipping container, worker in orange shirt and hard hat present.
Photo 1: close-up of a V-configuration diesel engine, heavily soiled with oil and dirt, sitting on wooden blocks; valve covers appear yellow/painted, no legible nameplate or serial tag visible.
Photo 2: rear/flywheel housing view of the same engine, showing a large circular bellhousing with bolt holes, rust and surface corrosion visible on metal housing.
A red canister (possibly a fuel filter or fire extinguisher) is clipped to the engine in all photos.
Watermark 'DNL EQUIPMENT SALES AND' overlays photos 0 and 2 - this is a seller/vendor watermark, not an identification plate.
No engine data plate, serial number, or 'CAT 3208' marking is legible in any photo.

identity.kind: V8 diesel marine engine (used, condition unverified)

claims.evidence: No nameplate, casting mark, or serial tag reading 'Caterpillar' or '3208' is visible in photo 0, 1, or 2; the engine's general V8 shape is consistent with some Cat 3208 units but this is not proof.
Photos show the engine block with some ancillaries (manifolds, filters, hoses) but no view of a marine gearbox, heat exchanger, or full accessory set to confirm 'complete' status.

risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed, which materially changes value (genuine Cat 3208 vs generic/rebuilt industrial diesel).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine data/ID plate or block casting number stamped on the block.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/unverified used diesel engine, not as a Caterpillar unit

risks.risk: Running condition unknown; engine shows heavy surface rust and grime suggesting long outdoor storage or non-use.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine starting and running, or a recent compression/oil pressure test result.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts or rebuild

risks.risk: Completeness for marine application (gearbox, heat exchanger, raw water pump, wiring harness) cannot be confirmed from engine-only shots.
risks.proof: Wide photos showing the full assembly including gearbox and cooling components, or an itemized parts list with photos.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare engine block only, excluding marine-specific ancillaries

risks.risk: Corrosion on flywheel housing and exposed metal may indicate internal rust or water ingress affecting rebuildability.
risks.proof: Photo of internal cylinder bores/flywheel teeth, or borescope video.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case, assuming internal corrosion present

risks.risk: Transport/handling damage risk, as engine is shown mid-lift with chains under load.
risks.proof: Photos after placement showing no new dents, cracks, or leaks post-handling.
risks.if_unproven: priced as-is with possible handling damage unverified

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine's data plate or block-stamped serial/model number.
Video of the engine cranking or running, with audio.
Wide shots showing all included ancillaries (gearbox, heat exchanger, alternator, wiring) to confirm 'complete marine engine' claim.
Photo of cylinder bores or flywheel gear teeth to assess internal corrosion.
response.reason: The seller's core claim, a Caterpillar 3208 marine engine, cannot be confirmed from any photo since no nameplate or serial number is legible, and this brand/model identity is the main driver of price; without it only a generic unbranded engine price would apply, which is too uncertain to set even a worst-case figure.
